payload.entry: Verified the approved plan and every note on all three closed phases against commits 312a030e9f (sase-1vc.1), 650492693a (sase-1vc.2), and 45a205c549 (sase-1vc.3), current source, and 70 passing focused tests (33.59s). Release evidence uses inventory, marker, then checkpoint project-file resolution; background evidence, queue, and hints share the host project key; inline drains retain the machine store; unmapped repositories skip and evidence-write failures remain resumable without a new primary commit. Success-path finalizer exceptions cannot enter provider-failure finalization in any exception branch; persisted attempt IDs continue above prior files/journal events without changing phase budgets or immutable writes. Macro and prepared completion callers do not rerun failed finalizers. The scratch_claim=hold decision is implemented: scratch cwd stays separate from the starter workspace, the supervisor holds its claim through stale cleanup and transfers it to the follow-up, workspace zero resolves to primary, and other managed checkout ownership stays first. Audited settlement observation, starter matching, and inherited obligations: all prioritize the retained workspace. Governing host-owned completion, fail-closed handoffs, machine-link-writes-off-primary, and Rust-core boundaries are preserved. Integration review: fetched origin; master and origin/master agree, with no unrelated commits since epic creation or its first implementation commit, so no drift edits are needed. Follow-up triage: no PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries or distinct unrelated defects were found; no proposals declined and no task beads needed. All descendants are closed; sase bead epic-symbols sase-1vc reports no entries. Existing phase just check passes are supplemented by the focused landing regression run; no primary-source changes in this landing.

Post-close verification: just symvision passed with all public/private symbols used properly. The linked plan frontmatter is now status: done. The post-close parent-link read and plan metadata show no parent_bead, so no ancestor closeout is required. Only the plans sidecar status changed; no primary-repository files changed.
